title: theodorea glomerata
intro: Theodorea glomerata, commonly known as Yellow Sandalwood, is a plant species native to Madagascar, characterized by its small, yellow flowers and aromatic wood. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in soothing wounds, reducing fever, and treating infections. The therapeutic actions of Theodorea glomerata include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in traditional medicine and aromatherapy. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, including santalol and santalene, which are responsible for its unique fragrance and therapeutic properties.
